supporting_observations.claim: WS-TWEBER-01 made repeated connections to the internal proxy at 10.51.20.30:8080, including at 13:40, 13:45, 13:50, 13:55, 14:00, 14:05, and 14:10 UTC. The recorded flow sizes are broadly similar, with an additional connection at 13:47.

The flows establish connections from WS-TWEBER-01 to the explicit proxy, but the available records do not identify the ultimate destination or the initiating application. The repeated timing is compatible with the inventory-described MediLedger updater checks, but does not establish that the updater generated these flows.
The supplied proxy-connection records begin at 13:40 UTC; they do not document the alerted outbound pattern at 13:30 or 13:35 UTC.

known_telemetry_limitations: The relevant Zeek records show connections to the internal proxy on port 8080, not the ultimate internet destinations.
The supplied records do not include proxy request logs, destination hostnames or URLs, HTTP CONNECT details, or TLS metadata for the proxy-mediated flows.
The available connection records do not associate the proxy flows with a process, executable, user, or application-level activity.
claims_not_established: Whether the proxy connections reached update.medledger.com or another destination.
Whether the connections were generated by the approved MediLedger updater or by another process.
Whether the encrypted or proxied traffic contained malicious activity.
Whether the alert's stated activity began at 13:30 UTC; the supplied proxy-flow records start at 13:40 UTC.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve PROXY-PIN-01 access and CONNECT logs for the listed times, including requested destinations, URLs where available, status codes, and client identity.
Obtain endpoint process-to-network telemetry for WS-TWEBER-01 during 13:20–14:20 UTC.
Check MediLedger updater logs and endpoint software/task records for corresponding checks at these times.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: WS-TWEBER-01 used explicit credentials for svc-billing via taskhostw at 13:24 UTC, although the inventory describes the BillingSync job as running on FILE-PIN-01. This does not establish a connection to the alerted proxy activity. (T065-00043)

Separate review: other workstations initiated TLS connections to WS-TWEBER-01 on port 443; the records identify the local hostname as the TLS server name but do not establish the purpose of the service. (T065-00028, T065-00030, T065-00151, T065-00152, T065-00197, T065-00198)
